about.title: About AI Tools for Real Estate
about.desc: We help real estate professionals discover, compare, and choose the best AI tools. Our mission, editorial standards, and team.
about.mission_body: The real estate industry is being transformed by artificial intelligence — from property valuation and lead generation to virtual staging and automated CRM. But with hundreds of AI tools flooding the market, finding the right one is overwhelming. We built AI Tools for Real Estate to cut through the noise. Every tool on this site is researched, tested, and reviewed with the needs of real estate professionals in mind.
about.how_body: We assess each AI tool across six dimensions: feature completeness, ease of use, pricing transparency, customer support quality, integration capabilities, and real-estate-specific functionality. Our reviews are based on hands-on testing, user feedback analysis, and direct vendor interviews. We update reviews every six months to keep information current.
about.editorial_body: We maintain a strict separation between editorial content and affiliate revenue. Tool rankings and review scores are determined solely by our evaluation criteria — never by commission rates or vendor relationships. When you click an affiliate link and make a purchase, we may earn a commission at no extra cost to you. This does not influence our assessments.
about.team_body: Our team combines deep expertise in real estate technology, AI/ML engineering, and content creation. Contributors include licensed real estate agents, data scientists, and software engineers who have collectively evaluated over 200 AI tools. Every piece of content goes through a multi-stage review process: AI-assisted research, human expert review, and final editorial approval.
about.update_body: The AI tool landscape changes rapidly. We re-evaluate every tool profile at least every six months and update pricing, features, and reviews accordingly. Each page displays a 'last reviewed' date so you know exactly how current the information is. Tools that have not been re-evaluated within six months carry a 'needs update' flag until refreshed.

legal.privacy_intro: This Privacy Policy explains how AI Tools for Real Estate collects, uses, and protects your personal information.
legal.privacy_collect_body: We collect information you provide directly, such as your email address when subscribing to our newsletter, and search queries you enter on our site. We also collect standard server log data including IP addresses, browser types, and pages visited, which helps us understand how visitors use our site.
legal.privacy_use_body: We use collected information to operate and improve the website, send newsletters to subscribers, analyze usage patterns, and prevent abuse. We do not sell, rent, or share your personal information with third parties for their marketing purposes.
legal.privacy_cookies_body: We use essential cookies for site functionality and analytics cookies to understand traffic patterns. No third-party advertising or tracking networks are employed. You can control cookie preferences through your browser settings.
legal.privacy_rights_body: Depending on your jurisdiction (including GDPR in the EU/EEA and CCPA in California), you may have rights to access, correct, delete, or port your personal data. To exercise these rights, contact us through the information provided on our Contact page.
legal.privacy_contact_body: For questions about this Privacy Policy or your personal data, please visit our Contact page.
legal.terms_intro: By accessing and using AI Tools for Real Estate (airealtools.com), you agree to these Terms of Service. If you do not agree, please do not use this website.
legal.terms_use_body: The content on this website is provided for informational purposes only. While we strive for accuracy, we make no warranties regarding the completeness or reliability of tool information, pricing data, or reviews. Users should verify critical information directly with tool vendors before making purchasing decisions.
legal.terms_affiliate_body: Some links on this website are affiliate links. When you click and make a purchase, we may receive a commission at no additional cost to you. Affiliate relationships do not influence our rankings, reviews, or recommendations. See our Affiliate Disclosure page for full details.
legal.terms_ip_body: All original content — including reviews, comparisons, tutorials, and data visualizations — is the intellectual property of AI Tools for Real Estate. You may share or quote our content with proper attribution and a link back to the original page. Tool logos and trademarks belong to their respective owners.
legal.terms_liability_body: AI Tools for Real Estate and its operators shall not be liable for any damages arising from the use of, or inability to use, this website or its content. This includes, but is not limited to, direct, indirect, incidental, and consequential damages.
legal.terms_changes_body: We may update these Terms of Service at any time. Changes will be posted on this page with an updated revision date. Continued use of the website after changes constitutes acceptance of the revised terms.
legal.disclosure_intro: Transparency is one of our core values. This page explains how we earn revenue and why you can trust our recommendations.
legal.disclosure_how_body: AI Tools for Real Estate participates in affiliate programs with several AI tool vendors. When you click on an affiliate link and complete a purchase or sign up for a free trial, we may earn a commission. This comes at no additional cost to you. In some cases, affiliate partnerships may provide us with early access to new features or extended trial periods for evaluation purposes.
legal.disclosure_editorial_body: Our reviews, ratings, and rankings are never influenced by affiliate revenue. We score tools against a standardized six-dimension rubric, applied uniformly to all products regardless of commercial relationship. Tools with higher commission rates do not receive higher scores or more prominent placement. Our comparison verdicts are based solely on feature analysis and user needs — not vendor relationships.
legal.disclosure_identify_body: Affiliate links on our site are marked with rel="sponsored" attributes for search engine transparency. When you hover over or click an affiliate link, you may see a brief disclosure notice. We believe you should always know when a link may result in financial compensation to us.
legal.disclosure_commitment_body: We built this directory to solve a real problem: finding the right AI tool for real estate work is hard. Earning affiliate revenue allows us to keep the site free, invest in deeper research, and expand our tool coverage. If you ever believe a review is biased or inaccurate, please contact us — we will investigate and correct any issues promptly.
